svg.desc: Static banner. Peter McVries, OSINT researcher and edge developer for the Vulnerable Defense League of New York. Thesis: what Wall Street hoards, we hand back. Free self-hosted tools, methods published. Contrast computed from hex against the page surface: primary text 17.73 to 1, accent 10.64 to 1, secondary label 9.20 to 1. No animation.
